item.title: ▫️ Detect and destroy: reconnaissance groups start practical operations during the Search 2026 exercises
item.description: ▫️ Detect and destroy: reconnaissance groups start practical operations during the Search 2026 exercises 📍 Chebarkulskiy training ground 💥 Reconnaissance groups have already moved to the designated areas to search for a mock enemy. To defeat the enemy, the servicemen use reconnaissance and attack FPV drones, as well as adjust artillery and aviation fire. ➡️ At the same time, the reconnaissance data units collect, analyse, and generalise the information acquired and transmit it to the Command of the CSTO CRRF. It enables the 'detect and destroy' principle to be implemented. The goal of the exercise is to conduct various types of reconnaissance in the interest of deploying the CSTO CRRF, as well as to improve the practical skills of the command and reconnaissance unit personnel. #CSTOexercise 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

▫️
Detect and destroy: reconnaissance groups start practical operations during the Search 2026 exercises
📍
Chebarkulskiy training ground
💥
Reconnaissance groups have already moved to the designated areas to search for a mock enemy. To defeat the enemy, the servicemen use reconnaissance and attack FPV drones, as well as adjust artillery and aviation fire.
➡️
At the same time, the reconnaissance data units collect, analyse, and generalise the information acquired and transmit it to the Command of the CSTO CRRF. It enables the 'detect and destroy' principle to be implemented.
The goal of the exercise is to conduct various types of reconnaissance in the interest of deploying the CSTO CRRF, as well as to improve the practical skills of the command and reconnaissance unit personnel.
#CSTOexercise
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29667

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
▫️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces tighten the encirclement around the AFU formations in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone.
💥
Inside the encirclement, there are battles for the settlements of Nesternoye, Lukashovo, Grachevka, and Rublenoye
in Kharkov region. Russian elements also neutralise enemy units near Varvarovka, Chernoye, Nefedovka, and Kupino (Kharkov region).
▪️
Over the past 24 hours, the enemy lost up to 60 troops, two ATVs, and one unmanned ground vehicle.
📍
While expanding the external control zone, Russian troops continue combat actions for Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
🔥
In addition,
in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered
at manpower and hardware of three heavy mechanised brigades, two mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, one territorial defence brigade, and one national guard brigade close to Slatino, Liptsy, Pitomnik, Tsupovka, Zhukov Yar, Velikiy Burluk, Mikhaylovka, Kutuzovka, and Shestakovo (Kharkov region).
🚩
In Sumy region, as a result of decisive actions of the Group's units established control over Ulanovo (Sumy region).
💥
Strikes were delivered
at enemy manpower and UAV command posts of two mechanised brigades and an airmobile brigade of the AFU close to Kiyanitsa, Khoten (Sumy region), and Sumy.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 285 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 21 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and three electronic warfare stations in the Sever Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU, one marine brigade, one territorial defence brigade, one national guard brigade close to Volchiy Yar, Bogorodichnoye, Sidorovo, Donetskoye, Lozovoye, Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic), Kovalevka, Osinovo, Grushevka, Maleyevka, Chervony Oskol, and Shevchenkovo (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to over 210 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 12 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of three mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades of the AFU, and one marine brigade were hit close to Vysokoivanovka, Druzhkovka, Slavyansk, Nikolayevka, Kramatorsk, Chervonozoryanoye, Krasny Molochar, and Nikonorovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 190 troops, one U.S.-made M113 armoured personnel carrier, four armoured fighting vehicles, 23 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one Grad MLRS vehicle.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 28 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉

Part 1
)
🚩
The Tsentr Group of Forces liberated Novovodyanoye (Donetsk People's Republic) by active actions.
💥
Strikes were delivered
at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Belozerskoye, Sergeyevka, Yuryevka, Novofedorovka, Novogrigorovka, Roganskoye, Maryevka, Pervomayskoye, Veseloye Pole (Donetsk People's Republic), Novopavlovka, and Novolozovatovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▫️
Over the past 24 hours, assault groups of the 51st Army have advanced in a western direction in north-eastern, central and southern parts of Dobropolye in the Donetsk People's Republic.
Marine units were operating in the eastern part of the city, destroying the enemy's fortified stronghold. Over the past 24 hours, 70 buildings have been liberated, up to 30 troops have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, up to 460 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, and one Grad MLRS were neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence
. Russian troops inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade, two air assault brigades, and one assault regiment of the AFU near Omelnik, Vasinovka, Mirolyubovka, Kievskoye, Obshcheye, Golubkovo, Samoylovka (Zaporozhye region), Orly, Dibrova, Vsesvyatskoye, and Podgavrilovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 180 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, and two artillery guns.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
The losses were inflicted on one mechanised brigade, one mountain assault brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade close to Preobrazhenka, Yurkovka, Kirovo, Orekhov, Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region) and Zaporozhye.
▪️
Up to 25 troops and eight motor vehicles were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on production workshops and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles and their components, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 151 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
10 guided aerial bombs and 442 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊

since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:

▫️
1,783
MLRS vehicles,
▫️
36,581
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
73,082
special military vehicles.

item.title: ▫️ Wolverine Path 2026 is passed! The joint Russian-Sri Lankan exercise Wolverine Path 2026 is completed in Primorye.
item.description: ▫️ Wolverine Path 2026 is passed! The joint Russian-Sri Lankan exercise Wolverine Path 2026 is completed in Primorye. 📍 Sergeyevsky training ground, Primorsky Krai ▫️ In the final phase of the exercise, personnel practised tactical tasks. The fighters operated as part of mixed crews on motor and armoured vehicles, buggies, armoured personnel carriers, and tanks, as well as carried out a heliborne landing from army aviation helicopters. 🤝 The exercise concluded with a ceremonial march. The militaries of the two countries exchanged souvenirs, received medals and unveiled a commemorative stone as a sign of combat friendship. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued launching group strikes
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued launching group strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and port infrastructure of Ukraine, as well as ships used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strikes, the following targets were neutralised: 📍 In Kiev: ▫️ Ukrtelecom data centre, which is one of the largest providers of fixed and mobile communications, as well as high-speed internet for the AFU; ▫️ DreamLine data centre , one of the largest companies providing high-speed internet services to the AFU, including data storage; ▫️ fuel infrastructure facilities are used in the interests of the AFU. ▫️ Infrastructure and facilities were hit at the Vasilkov military airfield infrastructure and facilities (Kiev region). 📍 In Odessa: ▫️ Novaya Pochta logistics centre, used to store military cargo. ▫️ in the port of Chernomorsk – a dry cargo ship with military materiel and dual-use cargo for the Armed Forces of Ukraine. ▫️ in the port of Izmail – Danubeshipservice plant infrastructure . A large shipbuilding and ship-repair enterprise, which restores and modernises watercraft, maintains and renovates shipyards. ▫️ A permanent deployment area of the Ukrainian State Border Service was also struck on the plant's territory. ▫️ In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to the port of Odessa was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
